 --> Odisha schools closed in 15 districts amid cyclone Akvan threat; check district-wise list
 Odisha has closed schools and educational institutions across 15 districts on November 20 as Cyclone Akvan threatens the state with heavy rainfall and strong winds. 
 Sheetal Kumari 
 November 20, 2026 / 11:00 IST Share --> 
 --> 
 --> 
 --> 
 Cyclone Akvan Tracker: Regional Meteorological Centre, Kolkata Odisha schools closed due to severe cyclone Akvan.
 Closures affect multiple districts from Nov 20 to 21.
 IMD warns of heavy rain and winds up to 110 kmph.
